extension.summary: Installs and updates the MediaHub skin
extension.description: Repository for the MediaHub streaming-style skin for movies and TV shows. Install the skin from Install from repository - MediaHub Repository - Look and feel - Skin, and it will be kept up to date automatically.

extension.summary: A streaming-app style skin for movies and TV shows
extension.description: MediaHub turns your Kodi movie and TV library into a modern streaming app: a rotating hero slider, network cards (Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, National Geographic, Star and 30+ more) that open a hub for that studio or network, and home rows you choose and reorder. Add titles to My List, rate them with thumbs up / down / love for better recommendations, and find more with More Like This, actor pages and a live search page. TV shows get a Disney+-style page with season tabs and movie collections get their own page, Up Next picks up where you left off, and NEW and 4K badges show what's new and in 4K. The player bar shows the title's clearart or logo with 4K, HDR, Dolby and 5.1 badges, with an Audio & Subtitles panel, a pause screen and Skip Intro / Recap / Credits buttons. There are also music screens with a now playing page, a Live TV guide, a screensaver made from your library, a "Who's watching?" profile screen, a Kids mode with a PIN and six accent colours.
extension.disclaimer: The network card artwork is plain typography. Studio and network names are trademarks of their respective owners.

extension.summary: Up Next, My List, thumbs and recommendations for the MediaHub skin
extension.description: Runs in the background for the MediaHub skin. It works out Up Next (the next episode of every TV show you are part-way through, with the following episodes queued when you play one), keeps My List, stores your thumbs up / down as the library's own "my rating", and ranks Recommended For You and More Like This from them. It also fills in collection pages, works out the NEW badges, lists the audio and subtitle tracks for the player's Audio & Subtitles panel, runs the MediaHub screensaver, plays trailer previews in the home rows, keeps Finish by, intro memory and the sound modes going while you watch, finds people when you search, picks a Surprise, works out Your year, downloads titles to watch offline and checks for MediaHub updates.
